entries.zh: 囚禁；关押（囚，亦指囚徒）
entries.en: to imprison; to jail (prisoner)

entries.zh: 监禁；牢狱
entries.en: to imprison; prison
entries.notes: M 栏首音写 [疑:l/m] 且有声调标记污损；据 H 監、R guiên 与词头 encarcelar 定监禁义。

entries.zh: 禁闭；监禁（禁，亦指禁止）
entries.en: to confine; to imprison (also: to prohibit)

entries.zh: 囚监：监禁；牢狱
entries.en: to imprison; prison, jail
entries.notes: M 栏第二音节 [疑:cā/ca] 且声调标记污损；H 囚監与 R chên guiên 互证监禁义。

entries.zh: 军：充军；拘押（释义存疑）
entries.en: to banish to military service; military confinement (uncertain)
entries.notes: H 栏'軍'与词头 encarcelar（囚禁）义不相合，且 M/R 声调均污损（[疑:cù/cû]）；或取明代充军刑名，或'軍'系'困'之形近误认，语义无法定夺。

entries.zh: 放脚军里：把脚置于脚枷／足械之中；上桎梏
entries.en: to put (his) feet in the stocks
entries.notes: 末音节 M [疑:quị/lị]、R [疑:kị/lị]，多处声调标记污损；与第 9 条 cepo（脚军）互证取置足械义。

entries.zh: 讼狱：狱讼；因讼被囚（诉讼与牢狱）
entries.en: litigation and imprisonment; to be jailed through lawsuit

entries.zh: 军禁：严密监禁；看守森严
entries.en: to confine securely; close imprisonment
entries.notes: M 栏混入西文'prendere le.'，首字声调标记污损；据 L 'encarcelar y estar mui seguro' 取拘禁严密义。

entries.zh: 脚军：脚枷（西语 cepo，夹足木械）；上脚枷
entries.en: foot-stocks (cepo); to put the feet in the stocks
entries.notes: 两音节声调标记均污损；据 L 'ponerlo de pies en el cepo' 定足械义。

entries.zh: 禁落天牢：关进天牢（将官员囚入天牢）
entries.en: to cast into the imperial prison; to imprison (a mandarin)

entries.zh: 囚禁：囚禁；关押
entries.en: to imprison; to keep in custody

entries.zh: 囚犯：囚犯；被囚之人
entries.en: prisoner; convict

entries.zh: 囚罪：因罪被囚；所犯之罪
entries.en: imprisonment for a crime; criminal guilt

entries.zh: 担：担任；承担（以之为职事）
entries.en: to take on; to assume (as one's office or duty)
entries.notes: M 栏首字母 [疑:fām/tām]（担之异写或他字）；据 R tâm 与 L 'como oficio' 取担任义。

entries.zh: 任：担任；负责其事（原字忍／任存疑）
entries.en: to undertake; to take charge of
entries.notes: H 栏 [疑:忍/任]、M 栏首音亦疑；据 L 'encargarse de algo' 义取'任'。

entries.zh: 担带（担待）：承担；揽负责任
entries.en: to take upon oneself; to bear (a charge)
entries.notes: off° 为 officio（职司）之缩写；首音节 [疑:tām/fām]。

entries.zh: 担当：担当；承当职任
entries.en: to take on; to assume responsibility
entries.notes: off° 为 officio 之缩写；首音节 [疑:tām/fām]。

entries.zh: 担受：承领；担受所任之事
entries.en: to accept and undertake
entries.notes: off° 为 officio 之缩写；R 栏第二音节 [疑:sîn/siū]（受），M 栏声调标记污损。

entries.zh: 担成（担承）：承当；担办其事
entries.en: to undertake; to take charge of and carry out
entries.notes: off° 为 officio 之缩写；M 栏并存两种读法（chiā̃/sēng）、R 栏 chêng 近'承'，首音节 [疑:tām/fām]。

entries.zh: 价上：涨价；价钱上涨
entries.en: to rise in price; to grow dear (of merchandise)
entries.notes: M/R 两栏音写均有 [疑]；据 H 價上 与 L encarecerse（货价腾贵）定涨价义。
